title: occ/{occ}/status payload
description: UPSERT payload of occ/{occ}/status. The copy is live while this is live and its head is present; removing the copy is a DELETE with an empty payload, and undo re-upserts it. Serialized, at most 142 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

status.description: The copy's one status register. `former` = no longer owned: live, kept, never counted as held.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
